description: Frozen held-out CVE→ATT&CK case IDs for the measured Live (DeepSeek) n=20 protocol. First 20 cve_to_attack cases in golden_dataset.json order (equivalent to --task cve_to_attack --limit 20 with seed=null). Do not cherry-pick or reorder for reporting.

selection.notes: Matches historical Live runs that used --limit 20 without --seed (file order). Multi-seed A/Bs still shuffle with fixed seeds for variance; primary headline numbers should use this held-out list via --heldout.

circl_import_future.notes: deepseek_live_n20 remains a separate protocol until CIRCL Live numbers exist. Neighbor ICL uses CIRCL train only (hard-exclude test IDs). Never train on techniques_derived / LLM-expanded labels.
